title: The Mills Brothers stranded and playing at his high school
summary: He remembers the Mills Brothers giving a school concert for $50 in 1932 and later confirming it with one of them.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Oh, yeah. You know, actually I have a recollection of the Mills Brothers coming through when they were down on their luck and they stopped in our high school and said, you know, $50.00 to get us to San Francisco, we'll give a concert to the kids. This was in 1932.

Now I asked -- later I worked with them a lot and became friendly with them and I think Harry's the one I asked about it. Of course, he wouldn't remember it. He said he doesn't remember Tracy, particularly, but he said, we did that plenty of times.
One of the Mills Brothers. Harry, I think. And I was telling him when I was a kid, I said, I've

got the strongest recollection that your group stopped in my high school. And I said, you know, you were famous then because I'd heard records of you. I said, was that a possibility? He said, yes, sometimes we'd get down on our luck. Had a record but, you know, in those days the artists didn't get all the money off that record. And they'd get stranded someplace and stop in a school or someplace and give a concert.
